text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaaah~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I finished the run. First off, what 
a relief—
(Eeeek~~!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gyah!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Yukino-chan~! You were running 
your heart out. Ah, youth~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looked so fresh and adorable! So 
this is what racing feels like~ It really 
makes you want to cheer them on.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, seriously...? She can totally 
run just fine, Yukino Bijin—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans A & B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chaaan! We'll come watch you 
again~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wooww...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It really does feel great. Running, and 
making people happy doing it—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —An' that's when I thought...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I wanna make everyone happy 
through my running... with my own 
strength."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it's just that people find me 
amusing because I'm a country bumpkin, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Somethin' like that ain't gonna last 
forever. A boom's a great opportunity, 
sure, but in the end, it always fades out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess you're right. I know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, my goal is to build up 
my skills and make people fall in love 
with my running!

Yukino Bijin is assessing her current 
situation much more calmly than I 
expected. In that case, the next thing to 
consider is...
choice_data_list: Shall we set a goal for the races as well?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! About that...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...No! That's just completely out of my 
league...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, I...
choice_data_list: Yukino, I'd love for you to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I... want to challenge the Triple Tiara!

"The Triple Tiara... That is the title 
given to those who conquer all three 
Classic-tier races: the Oka Sho, the Oaks, 
and the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Talkin' 'bout the Triple Tiara, that's 
insane stuff. Challengin' it might be 
totally reckless. But..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The Tiara sparkles... It's so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but admire it. Just the sound 
of the word 'Tiara'...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides! If I can win the Triple Tiara, 
that'll prove I really have what it takes, 
right?

Every race is contested by the top 
Umamusume of their generation. Anyone who 
triumphs here is undeniably top-class.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Course, it might be tough for someone 
like me, but..."
choice_data_list:
Your running is wonderful, have confidence 
in yourself!

Your running is wonderful— have 
confidence!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Triple Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: First up is the Oka Sho!

"Even so, there's still time until the Oka 
Sho. I'd like to set a target race a bit 
sooner. If we follow the standard 
route..."

The Hanshin JF is a valuable Junior-class 
GⅠ. Girls who perform well here often go 
on to show incredible running on the Tiara 
path as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's the race City-san won, right?! I've 
watched the footage countless times!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't even count how many times I've 
wished I could be like City-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want to run! In the Hanshin JF!

And so, our next goal was set for the 
Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...An' that's how I ended up takin' on the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Huuuh... Sorry, I'm not really 
knowledgeable about this. Is that really 
such a big deal?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible! Lemme see, if it were 
skating...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ain't there a really strong kid in Nagoya 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"There she is. The favorite to win the 
world tournament."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm trying to win in a field 
of 18 girls, including myself, who are all 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: "Gyaaah! That's freakin' amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! I'm tryin' to take on a reckless 
fight.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true at all! After all, 
Yuki-chan wasn't the only one who made the 
decision, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer decided that we could do it, 
right? Then everything's gonna be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! Trainer praised my running, 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ""...Must be nice.""

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Mifuyu-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"No way! I can't just keep complaining 
about being bad at jumping. I need to get 
to the starting line right away!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats again on your debut, Yuki-chan! 
I'll be cheering you on!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll put on a real good run at the 
next Hanshin JF!
